title: tpm2-tools 2a follow-up: inert device list, grandchild test headroom, FIFO-safe adopt, EISDIR open-vs-access test (#301 round 2 new 7, 5, 2, 1)
description: First follow-up to the #301 round 2 APPROVE (verdict on WCLI-21). New 7: replace the readdirSync /dev sweep in test/tpm2-tools.test.ts with an explicit inert candidate list (/dev/mem, /dev/port, /dev/kmsg), still failing on zero candidates on Linux, because opening /dev/watchdog O_RDWR can arm a hardware timer. New 5: the grandchild test ran in 301 ms against its 300 ms bound, so give it a 2-3 s bound, a 60 s grandchild sleep, a ceiling well under that, and the kill in a finally. New 2: add O_NONBLOCK|O_NOCTTY to adoptToolFile's open and a FIFO-refused-promptly test. New 1: a test that defaultOpenCheck on a temp directory throws EISDIR (open(2) refuses, access(2) passes), and tighten the default-path regex to tpm_not_accessible. Lands in one small PR before or at the start of 2b.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The default-device-check test opens only an explicit inert list of devices and fails on zero candidates on Linux
The grandchild test has a bound with headroom over cold start and kills the grandchild in a finally
adoptToolFile refuses a FIFO at the path promptly, with a test, and never blocks
A test distinguishes open(2) from access(2) through EISDIR and the default-path regex names tpm_not_accessible
